tools.name: db_databases
tools.description: The databases the person saved in Sikemux: name, engine (postgres or sqlite), where it is, and whether you may change data in it. Name one in the other db_* tools.

tools.name: db_tables
tools.description: The schemas of a saved database, and the tables and views in one of them.

database.description: A saved database's name, from db_databases.

schema.description: Default: public for PostgreSQL, main for SQLite.

tools.name: db_describe
tools.description: One table or view: its columns with types, nullability, defaults and primary key, its indexes and its foreign keys.

tools.name: db_query
tools.description: Run SQL on a saved database. Several statements may be separated by semicolons; each returns its columns and rows, or the rows it changed. Read-only unless the person allowed agents to change data in that database. Stops after 60 seconds. The person sees every query in the database's history.

limit.description: Rows kept from each statement. Default 100.
